problems.q: How many neutrons are in one atom of sulfur-34? Sulfur has atomic number 16.
problems.why: Neutrons = mass number − atomic number = 34 − 16 = 18. OpenStax AF2e §2.3.
hints: The 34 is the mass number. Subtract the 16 protons.

problems.q: An element has two isotopes. 80.0% of the atoms have mass 20.00 u and 20.0% have mass 22.00 u. What is the average atomic mass, in u?
hints: Turn each percent into a decimal before you multiply it by that isotope’s mass.
